title: Extension of principal divisors across the open curve
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, C a smooth affine connected integral Noetherian curve, and c a compactification with smooth connected integral Noetherian ambient curve Z of relative dimension one. For every unit a of the function field of C there exists a unit b of the function field of Z such that div_Z(b)(P)=div_C(a)(Q) for every pair of closed points Q,P with c.i(Q)=P. No orders at omitted points are prescribed. [def-sc-curves, lem-sc-compactification, def-sc-divisor, def-sc-picard-group, def-sc-function-field].

proof.text: By Mathlib genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion, c.i maps the generic point of C to that of c.Z. Compose stalkCongr for this equality with asIso of the open-immersion generic stalk map, obtaining an explicit ring equivalence e from c.Z.functionField to C.functionField. Set b to Units.map e.symm applied to a. This is a real construction; no existence theorem is used to choose data.

At Q use the stalk isomorphism of c.i. The stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply naturality theorem proves that this local-ring equivalence commutes with e and the algebra maps into the function fields. The open embedding preserves coheight by IsOpenEmbedding.coheight_eq.

The proved private helpers establish order invariance: Module.length_quotient expresses Ring.ord as coheight of a principal ideal; Submodule.orderIsoMapComap of the semilinear ring equivalence identifies the principal ideals, and Order.coheight_orderIso gives equal lengths. Thus ordMonoidWithZeroHom agrees. IsFractionRing.div_surjective expresses a nonzero rational function as a quotient with nonzero numerator and denominator; ordFrac_eq_ord and map_div₀ give fraction-order compatibility. In coheight one, ord_eq_ordHom_of_coheight_eq_one converts this into equality of scheme orders; at any other coheight both orders are zero. Apply this compatibility to e.symm a, then rewrite Scheme.div_apply and the point equality.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.exists_principal_divisor_open_extension
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g]
    [hsm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 c.g]
    [IsIntegral C] [IsNoetherian C] [IsIntegral c.Z] [IsNoetherian c.Z]
    (a : Additive C.functionFieldˣ) :
    ∃ b : Additive c.Z.functionFieldˣ,
      ∀ (P : closedPoints c.Z) (Q : closedPoints C), c.i.base Q.val = P.val →
        c.Z.div b P = C.div a Q
